text: Four test files pin construction and search results. `libsufr/tests/oracle.rs` builds every small input in `table()` under several flag sets against a reference sort and LCP; an input starting with `>` is inline FASTA. `libsufr/tests/search.rs` holds hand-derived search results, opened in all eight storage and cap modes. `libsufr/tests/header.rs` reads back the header of `1.fa` built with and without LCP. `sufr/tests/cli.rs` pins the CLI; `create_bytes_match_fixtures` compares 12 fixtures byte for byte.
